title: First-Time Visitor Review Kit
purpose: Convert subjective first impressions into public-safe evidence about whether seri.ai clearly represents Ravikanth Seri, his work, and the Operational Intelligence thesis.
principle: A serious review should identify whether the visitor can explain Ravikanth Seri, name the Operational Intelligence thesis, state what became clear, name what stayed confusing, cite what evidence was inspected, identify the strongest claim, and say what evidence would change the reviewer's mind.

reviewPath.question: Can a first-time visitor explain who Ravikanth Seri is and why this site exists within three minutes?
Can the visitor connect Ravikanth's enterprise systems background to the current Operational Intelligence work without relying on self-promotion?
Can the visitor identify what has been built, what is public-safe to inspect, and what should not be inferred?
Can the visitor name the evidence that would strengthen or weaken the Operational Intelligence model?
Does OI-ROOM-001 make evidence, contradiction, missing context, hypothesis movement, and human approval clearer than a generic demo?
Can the reviewer submit useful feedback with public-safe boundaries and without exposing protected operational material?

reviewQuestions: What was clear after the first three minutes?
What was still confusing after the first three minutes?
Can you explain who Ravikanth Seri is without repeating homepage copy?
Can you name the Operational Intelligence thesis in one sentence?
Which public artifact did you inspect before forming an opinion?
Which claim felt strongest, and why?
Which claim would you challenge first?
What evidence would change your mind?
What would block a real implementation?
Can you explain what Ravikanth's GitHub and Sentinalai public work show without inferring private production proof?
Would you describe the site as Ravikanth Seri's public professional operating system, an Operational Intelligence reference, or something else?
Did any page feel like a demo rather than a durable technical reference?
